_comment: Round-3 user-study candidates: brief sound-linked face/mouth events (laugh, sneeze, gasp, bark, scream, meow, yawn, neigh) on existing sources; events -> any-window critic objective. group r3 = retake-size sources (2 GPUs), r3_gen = H3-generated sources (3 GPUs).

man_laughs.question: Does the man laugh out loud (open mouth, laughing expression) at any point in this video? Answer only 'yes' or 'no'.
